intent: Follow a gentle-looking buttercup trail through flower fields, rolling hills and a narrow path to a quiet pond. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The gentle meadow
sections.lesson: Hop the low countryside fences. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
